item.configurationblocks.configurator.to: Right-click a block to configure it
Sneak + right-click to reset its configuration
screen.configurationblocks.title: Configurator: %s
message.configurationblocks.locked: This block is locked by its owner
screen.configurationblocks.paint.title: Paint block face
screen.configurationblocks.hardness.tip: Mining hardness. Empty = vanilla, -1 = unbreakable (like bedrock).
screen.configurationblocks.blast.tip: 17 or more = immune to explosions. Lower values give a proportional chance to survive. Empty = vanilla.
screen.configurationblocks.redstone.tip: Redstone signal strength emitted by the block (0-15).
screen.configurationblocks.bounce.tip: Trampoline strength. 0 = off. Sneak to avoid bouncing.
screen.configurationblocks.gravity.tip: The block falls like sand when nothing is below it.
screen.configurationblocks.lock.tip: Only you (or operators) can open, edit and break this block.
screen.configurationblocks.spawner.tip: Entity id to spawn, e.g. minecraft:zombie. Use the Mobs... button to browse.
screen.configurationblocks.sp_min.tip: Minimum time between spawns in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second).
screen.configurationblocks.sp_max.tip: Maximum time between spawns in ticks. Equal to min delay = fixed speed.
screen.configurationblocks.sp_count.tip: How many mobs are spawned per attempt (1-64).
screen.configurationblocks.sp_near.tip: Spawning stops when this many mobs of the type are already nearby.
screen.configurationblocks.sp_player.tip: The spawner works only if a player is within this many blocks (1-128).
screen.configurationblocks.sp_radius.tip: Mobs appear within this many blocks of the spawner (1-16).
screen.configurationblocks.picker.title: Select a mob
